title: Design System: Visionary Design Engine
note: Sidecar for the tokens DESIGN.md frontmatter cannot carry: shadows, motion, focus rings and backdrop filters. Per-vision values are NOT duplicated here — packages/design-system/src/vde-themes/*.theme.ts is the only source of truth for those, and scripts/validate-design-floors.mjs is what holds them to the floors.

ambient.description: The resting shadow on a surface. Tightened to a seam in the eleven visions whose hairline defines the edge; left wide in immersive and synthwave, which drop the hairline instead.

hard.description: An offset shadow with no blur. Brutalist and terminal idiom.

neon.description: A coloured glow. Deliberate character in terminal, immersive, synthwave, solarpunk and y2k_chrome; none in the other eight.

rules: The standard easing must not overshoot — it drives every Button, Card and Input transition, so a cubic-bezier with a control point above 1 makes routine state changes wobble. Overshoot belongs on emphatic.
Every ambient or looping animation is disabled under prefers-reduced-motion, enforced globally in global.css rather than per component.
Transitions name their properties. transition-all animates layout properties and stutters.

focus.rule: Every interactive element has a visible focus-visible treatment. Border-colour-only focus is not sufficient; axe asserts this per story in the Storybook test runner.

backdrop.rule: Blur is a vision's choice, not a default. It is 0px in seven visions; immersive at 14px and synthwave at 10px are the ones where layering is the thesis.

measure.rule: Prose slots cap here. Inside the 65-75 character readable band.

floors.contrast: WCAG AA 4.5:1 on seven foreground/background pairs, both modes, all 13 visions
